GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (26 May 46) GB
(SCAPIN - 985)
APO 500
26 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Japanese Nationals.
1 The Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend and deliver to the authorities at Sugamo Prison, for temporary detention, the following individuals:
Colonel ITO Kiyokazu -
Former Asst. Mil. Attache, Stockholm, Sweden
Major KIGOSHI, Yazukazu-
Former Asst. Mil. Attache, Stockholm, Sweden
Major SATO, Tatsuya -
Former Asst. Mil. Attache, Stockholm, Sweden
SATO, Kichinosuke (civilian) -
Mitsui representative, Stockholm, Sweden
INOUYE, Yoichi (Civilian) -
Mitsubishi representative, Stockholm, Sweden
Colonel ONOUCHI, Hirosi -
Former Mil. Attache, Helsinki, Finland
SUGIHARA, Kyune (?) -
Former Consul, Koenig sberg
2. Deliver to Sugamo Prison will be made immediately.
3. In the event delivery is impossible, the government will submit to this headquarters a report concerning the individual's present whereabouts and reason for nonarrest.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
